subject: BrightMetrics observability onboarding — dashboards, tracing, runbooks
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@brightmetrics.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: [BrightMetrics] Observability onboarding — kickoff questions

Hi Ava / Laura,

Thanks for the intro — BrightMetrics is excited to get Redwood onboarded for our production observability. A few items we want to make sure are covered in the initial implementation: dashboards for request/latency/error breakdown by customer, tracing hook guidance for our request router, an error taxonomy so our SREs know priorities, alert routing into our Ops Slack, and a handoff-ready runbook.

I'm attaching our current alert dump so you can see what we're working with (current-alerts.csv). High level answers:
- We run three prod clusters across us-west/us-east (traffic split 70/30)
- We have a 99.9% token-generation availability SLO
- Primary oncall is #brightmetrics-ops in Slack, secondary is PagerDuty (esc to oncall)

Can we do a 45-minute kickoff next week? Also please let me know what access you need (Grafana/CloudWatch/Jira) and any prework we should complete.

Cheers,
Samir Shah
Head of Platform
BrightMetrics

Attachments: current-alerts.csv (CSV, 43 KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@brightmetrics.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [BrightMetrics] Observability onboarding — kickoff questions

Hi Samir — thanks for the context and the CSV. This is the right scope. Quick answers up front: we’ll cover dashboards, tracing instrument guidance, an error taxonomy document, deterministic alert routing, and a runbook template.

Proposed next steps:
- Kickoff call (45 min): propose Tue 2028-05-23 10:00 PT or Wed 2028-05-24 09:00 PT — what works?
- Prework: please grant read-only access to Grafana/Dashboards or export sample dashboard JSON; a CloudWatch or Prometheus read role is ideal. If access will take time, share a read-only snapshot or screenshots.
- Deliverables (initial): implementation plan spreadsheet, sample dashboards, tracing hook checklist, an example runbook to hand to oncall.

I’ve attached a short pre-onboarding form that helps us capture data sources and alert contacts (pre-onboarding-form.pdf). Laura will own the runbook template; Marissa will lead implementation.

Laura / Marissa — can you confirm your owners and if you want additional internal attendees?

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

Attachments: pre-onboarding-form.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@brightmetrics.com>, ava.chen@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-21T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [BrightMetrics] Observability onboarding — implementation plan (draft)

Samir / team — looping with an initial implementation plan (see attached redwood-obs-implementation-plan.xlsx). Highlights:

Week 0 (prep)
- Access: read-only Grafana/CloudWatch, service account with metrics/trace read, sample request traces (low-PII)
- Prework: BrightMetrics fills the pre-onboarding form and provides SLO targets and alert owners

Week 1 (tracing + core dashboards)
- Add tracing hooks in request router (we’ll provide a small middleware snippet)
- Deploy 3 starter dashboards: request-volume, p50/p99 latency, errors-by-service/customer

Week 2 (alert routing + taxonomy)
- Define error taxonomy (P0/P1/P2) with examples
- Configure alert routing into Slack + PagerDuty escalation mapping

Week 3 (runbooks + handoff)
- Draft runbooks for common incidents (high-latency, token-starvation, model-fallback)
- Run tabletop with BrightMetrics SREs and finalize handoff checklist

Open questions:
1) Do you have tracing header conventions today (e.g., b3/traceparent) or should we standardize on W3C traceparent?
2) Which dashboard backend is primary (Grafana vs. internal UI)?
3) Any compliance restrictions on sharing traces outside your VPC?

I'll be the implementation lead for the dashboards and runbooks; Laura will author the example runbook and own the tabletop session. Ava will drive coordination.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-obs-implementation-plan.xlsx (Excel, 28 KB)

From: Samir Shah <samir@brightmetrics.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ava.chen@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-23T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [BrightMetrics] Observability onboarding — implementation plan (answers)

Thanks Marissa — this plan looks reasonable. Quick answers to your open Qs:
1) We currently emit W3C traceparent across the stack, so standardizing on that is perfect.
2) Primary dashboards live in Grafana (managed by BrightMetrics); we can provide read-only tokens and JSON exports.
3) Traces can be exported to Redwood for onboarding if they strip all user PII; we can provide redacted sample traces.

Additional context:
- PagerDuty service ID: PDR-88A
- Preferred SLAs: 99.9 availability, alert for token latency > 500ms at p99
- Slack channel: #brightmetrics-ops (we’ll invite redwood-bot)

We’ll fill the pre-onboarding form tonight and upload the dashboard JSON. Happy to do Tue 05/24 at 09:00 PT for the kickoff if that still works for your team. Also please send your runbook template so our oncall can review before the tabletop.

Samir

BrightMetrics Ops (ops@brightmetrics.com)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@brightmetrics.com>
Cc: ava.chen@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-24T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [BrightMetrics] Observability onboarding — kickoff confirmed + runbook template

Samir — great, thanks for the answers and for confirming the kickoff. Confirmed: Tue 2028-05-24 09:00 PT (45 min). Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=obs-kickoff-brightmetrics

Attached is our runbook-template.md (simple markdown template) and a sample dashboard screenshot so you can see the naming conventions we use. For the tabletop we'll run through: detection -> mitigation -> communication -> postmortem steps for the top 3 incident types.

Pre-kickoff checklist for BrightMetrics:
- Upload Grafana JSON export or provide read-only token (dashboard export preferred)
- Provide two redacted sample traces for tracing hook verification
- Confirm PagerDuty service ID and Slack invite (you provided PDR-88A and #brightmetrics-ops)

If anything changes, ping me in Slack; otherwise we'll see you Tue morning.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: runbook-template.md (Markdown, 4 KB), dashboard-screenshot.png (PNG, 90 KB)
